A neighbour recently contacted me because different people appear to be entering the apartment every few days with suitcases. top.headline: Tenant illegally listing Dubai apartment as holiday home
top.summary: A landlord discovered their Dubai Marina tenant is unlawfully subletting the rented apartment on holiday home websites. Multiple unfamiliar guests have been spotted entering the property with luggage.
top.why: It highlights legal risks and unauthorized subletting issues for Dubai landlords.
